# Sparkline
Atlas Sparkline v1 — a tiny trend line, with an optional soft fill under it, that shows the shape of one series next to a number. 2 forms (line, area), 3 tones (neutral, positive, negative) and 3 heights (sm, md, lg).

USE WHEN
· A KPI or table row needs the shape of a trend beside its number (visitors over 7 days).
· Space is tight and one series is enough.
· The exact values are available elsewhere in text.
DON'T USE WHEN
· Values, axes or a tooltip matter → Chart.
· Exact rows of data → Table.
· Several series are compared → Chart.
· Progress toward a goal → Progress.
HOW TO USE
· Pass the values in time order; the line runs left to right and does not mirror in right-to-left languages.
· Always give a text label that says what the trend shows ("Visitors, last 7 days, rising"); the drawing is not read by assistive technology.
· Tone says whether the trend is good, not its direction: positive success, negative danger, neutral muted. Pair it with words (Up, Down, Flat) in the card text; colour is never the only signal.
· Use area for a hero tile, line in dense rows. Keep the same size in a row.
· In Figma the drawn curve is a sample; it cannot take data.
DO
· One series per sparkline.
· Match the tone to the sentiment of the delta beside it.
DON'T
· Add axes, points, gridlines or a tooltip.
· Use colour alone to show up or down.
RELATED
· Chart — a full chart with axes and a legend.
· Stat card — the KPI card a sparkline sits beside.
· Progress — one value toward a target.

PROPERTIES
Variant: line | area. Tone: neutral | positive | negative. Size: sm | md | lg (height 24, 32, 40).
